Name: Community Center With Swag
Author: grubcore
Description:
super simple mod that just updates that little front area of the community center once it's been completed! i thought it looked sad and boring out there after the whole building gets fixed up, so i wanted to make it less sad and boring. nothing too fancy, since it wanted it to fit in with the aesthetic of the rest of the world.

NOTE THAT [b]CHANGES ONLY APPLY AFTER CC HAS BEEN COMPLETED![/b]

[size=1](ignore the clipping in the images btw, i didn’t realize i messed up until after i put everything together. i went in and fixed the map files so they’ll look fine in your actual game, but i don’t feel like taking new screenshots so. it is what it is.)[/size]

[u]COMPATIBLE WITH ALL MAP RECOLORS
[/u]
- Starblue Valley? yup. Wittily Named? mhm. Earthy? you betcha. no matter what recolor you use, your community center can have swag too, just like the rest of us.

- aside from map recolors, this mod [i]should [/i]work fine with anything else! from what I've seen, NPC pathing readjusts on its own to go around new obstacles! HOWEVER mods that add events which utilize tiles that are being taken up by this mod probably won't work properly and may cause problems in your game! so please be aware of what mods you have and how they may conflict with this one!

- if you notice any issues, don't hesitate to reach out and let me know so i can fix them asap!

- as of now, the mod is [b]incompatible with SDVE[/b][i]. [/i]the map changes of the latter conflict with those of CC With Swag. i do not play with SDVE, so it's unlikely that this will be changed in the foreseeable future.

[u]7/10/2023: NOW COMPATIBLE WITH ANY AND ALL MAP RECOLORS![/u]
- [b]HUGE huge thanks to beyondrecovery[/b] (creator of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13609]Immersive Sandy[/url] fyi) for letting me know that i was doing things in the most unnecessary and inconvenient way possible! with her help, CC With Swag should now automatically work with ALL map recolors with no issues!
